observations: White game console standing vertically, wrapped in clear plastic.
Xbox logo visible on the top surface in photo 0 and photo 1.
Front face appears smooth with no visible disc slot, but it is covered in plastic wrap.
Seller's hand and black wristwatch visible holding the unit.
Background shows a shop window with a 'BLESSED OBIVENTURES' watermark and printed images of a hard drive and controller.

claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a white Xbox console, but no readable model plate confirms the All-Digital Edition.
front face looks smooth but is wrapped in plastic, so the absence of a disc drive cannot be confirmed.
dimensions cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or is faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting up and reaching the home screen.

risks.risk: Missing controller, cables, or power supply.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories together.

risks.risk: Console is account-locked or banned from online services.
risks.proof: Screenshot of initial setup or network connection test.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides unwrapped.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the menu.
Photo of all included accessories (controller, HDMI, power cable).
Close-up photos of the front and back ports with the plastic removed.
response.reason: Photos show a white Xbox-branded console consistent with an Xbox One S All-Digital Edition, but the model is unreadable and functionality is unproven, so it can be priced at worst case as a non-working unit without accessories.
